definition: The quality of being exceptionally beautiful or delightful.
author: Mark Twain
quote: She moved like one of those bright beings pictured in the sunny walks of fancy’s Eden by the romantic and young, a queen of beauty unadorned save by her own transcendent loveliness.
example_sentence: The loveliness of the frosty morning almost made up for the late bus.
